# ProjectBase — AI Agent & LLM Integration Reference

> Ultra-lightweight, high-performance Plane & Linear alternative for multi-project Kanban and sprint management.
> Host: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120} (Tailscale LAN) / http://localhost:8120
> Engine: PocketBase (Go + SQLite) + Zero-Build Vue 3 UI
> OpenAPI Spec: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/openapi.json
> Interactive Docs: ${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}/docs/

## Key Projects & Identifiers
- PB: ProjectBase Core (Plane & Linear alternative with Vue 3 + PocketBase)
- LOAD: LoadETA (Real-time freight dispatching & driver ETA optimization)
- IBR: iBrowse (Headless browser automation, E2E QA, & console audits on :3000)
- HOME: Homelab Infrastructure (Ubuntu server, Tailscale mesh, & monitoring)
- OMNI: OmniRoute (AI Gateway & multi-model proxy on :20128)
- MEM: Memrize (Unified memory layer & knowledge graph)

## Agent FastMCP Setup
Add to ~/.cursor/mcp.json or ~/.flomaster/config.json:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "projectbase": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["run", "/data/projects/projectbase/scripts/mcp_server.py"],
      "env": { "PROJECTBASE_URL": "${PROJECTBASE_URL:-http://localhost:8120}" }
    }
  }
}

## Core Agent Tools & Endpoints
1. Quick Task Creation: POST /api/projectbase/quick-task {"project_key":"LOAD","title":"Task name","status":"todo","priority":"high"}
2. Query Issues: GET /api/collections/issues/records?filter=(project='<ID>')&sort=order,-created
3. Update Status: PATCH /api/collections/issues/records/<ID> {"status":"in_progress" | "done"}
4. Append Audit Comment: POST /api/collections/comments/records {"issue":"<ID>","author":"Flomaster Agent","author_type":"agent","content":"Summary"}
5. Export Issues (data portability — mirrors the importer columns so an exported
   file can be re-imported into another ProjectBase or Linear/Plane/Trello):
   - CSV:  GET /api/projectbase/export/csv?project=<ID>   (attachment download)
   - JSON: GET /api/projectbase/export/json?project=<ID>  (machine-readable)
6. Custom Fields (per-project, Linear-style properties):
   - List defs:    GET  /api/projectbase/projects/<ID>/custom-fields
   - Replace defs: PUT  /api/projectbase/projects/<ID>/custom-fields {"fields":[{"label":"Client","type":"text"},{"label":"Gate","type":"select","options":["P0","P1"]}]}
   - Validate:     POST /api/projectbase/projects/<ID>/custom-fields/validate {"values":{"client":"Acme"}}
   - Types: text | number | select | checkbox | date
7. Bulk Actions (board/list multi-select — up to 500 ids per call):
   - Bulk update: POST /api/projectbase/issues/bulk-update {"ids":["<ID>",...],"data":{"status":"in_progress","priority":"high","cycle":"<CYCLE_ID>"}}
     Allowed data fields: status, priority, cycle, milestone, estimate, start_date, due_date, labels, order + per-project custom_* fields. Returns {"updated":N,"missing":N,"total":N}.
   - Bulk delete: POST /api/projectbase/issues/bulk-delete {"ids":["<ID>",...]} (admin/manager only). Returns {"deleted":N,"missing":N,"total":N}.
8. Issue Relationships (blocks / blocked_by / related — reciprocal edges auto-mirrored):
   - List:   GET    /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations
   - Add:    POST   /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations {"issue":"<TARGET_ID>","type":"blocks"|"blocked_by"|"related"}
   - Remove: DELETE /api/projectbase/issues/<ID>/relations {"issue":"<TARGET_ID>","type":"blocks"|"blocked_by"|"related"}
7. In-app Notifications (recipient-only inbox, hook-generated):
   - List:   GET  /api/collections/notifications/records?sort=-created
   - Read:   PATCH /api/collections/notifications/records/<ID> {"read":true}
   - Read all: POST /api/projectbase/notifications/read-all
8. Full Agent Guide: GET /llms-full.txt
